mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_experiences WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT * FROM user_experiences WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND success = true ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM user_experiences WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_type = #{taskType} AND success = true ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT task_type AS taskType, COUNT(*) AS count FROM user_experiences WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY task_type
SELECT AVG(rating) FROM user_experiences WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND rating IS NOT NULL
SELECT * FROM user_experiences WHERE created_at > #{since} AND success = true ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_experiences (user_id, tenant_id, task_type, task_input, task_output, success, duration_ms, rating, feedback, tags, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tenantId}, #{taskType}, #{taskInput}, #{taskOutput}, #{success}, #{durationMs}, #{rating}, #{feedback}, #{tags}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_experiences SET user_id = #{userId}, tenant_id = #{tenantId}, task_type = #{taskType}, task_input = #{taskInput}, task_output = #{taskOutput}, success = #{success}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, rating = #{rating}, feedback = #{feedback}, tags = #{tags}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
